newsitem.title: INDIA: Stanley Works says wins major India orders.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Works says wins major India orders.

text.p: Stanley International Holdings Inc, a division of U.S. Stanley Works, said on Monday it had won orders from leading Indian automobile manufacturers for precision fastening tools.

The company said in a statement faxed to Reuters that it had received orders from India's biggest car manufacturer Maruti Udyog Ltd, besides the Indian ventures of Peugeot, Ford and Delphi, a General Motors subsidiary, for their assembly operations in India.
"Right now they are not manufacturing, they are setting up base," a Stanley Works spokeswoman said.
But she said she could not give any details on the size of the orders.
Stanley Works is a U.S.-based company which produces tools, hardware and specialty hardware.
